commitMessage: fix: OCNNOutputLayer mmuli requires 2D output buffer, not 1D
notes: Both OCNNOutputLayer tests now pass. Fix: doOutput() allocated 1D output array for mmuli but matmul requires 2D. Changed to [batchSize, 1] allocation with w.reshape(w.length(), 1), then reshape output back to 1D. File fixed: OCNNOutputLayer.java:253-255.
